description: Configure the function of the module here

content.name: min-xp
content.humanName: XP given at least for messages
content.description: How much XP the user gets at least for each message

content.name: max-xp
content.humanName: XP given at most for messages
content.description: How much XP the user gets at most for each messages

content.name: voiceXPPerMinute
content.description: How many XP will be given to users per minute when they are in a voice channel with other members. No XP will be given if they are alone in their channel or are muted or deafened. Numbers will be rounded and XP will be given every 15 minutes or when the user leaves the channel.

content.name: cooldown
content.description: In ms. How much cooldown there is between each XP getting

content.name: curveType

content.displayName: Exponentiation (softer start, harder leveling after level 14)

content.description: Type of the leveling curve. The exponential curve is recommended, as archiving new levels gets harder the higher your level is. Leveling is always the same if you use the linear curve.

links.label: Calculate how much XP is needed to level up

content.name: customLevelCurve

links.label: Calculate how much XP is needed to level up

content.description: Your custom leveling formula. Use the x variable (and no other variables). The result of the formula should be the required XP to reach level x (your variable). Example: "x*750+((x-1)*500)" (our default level curve)

content.name: levelUpMessagesConditions
content.description: This settings changes in which cases a level up message should be sent. With the setting "all", level up messages will be sent at every level up. With the setting "only-role-rewards", level up messages will only be sent if the new level has a role reward. With the "none" setting, no level up messages will be sent.

content.name: level_up_channel_id
content.description: Channel in which Level-Up-Messages should get send. (Leave empty to disable)

content.name: sortLeaderboardBy
content.description: How the leaderboard should be sorted

content.name: blacklisted_channels
content.description: Blacklisted-Channels in which users can not earn XP

content.name: blacklistedRoles
content.description: These roles won't receive XP when writing messages

content.name: reward_roles
content.description: Level at which users should get roles. Parameter 1: Level, Parameter 2: Role-ID

content.name: multiplication_roles
content.description: Allows you to configure roles that have a higher multiplication factor than normal (default value is 1). If a user has more than one of the configured roles, the multiplication factors get multiplied together before multiplying the result with the amount of XP the user receives for their message.

content.name: multiplication_channels
content.description: Allows you to configure channels that have a higher multiplication factor than normal (default value is 1). Messages sent in these channels will have their XP value multiplied by the multiplier configured here.

content.name: onlyTopLevelRole
content.description: If enabled, all previous level roles a user had will get removed, when they advance to a new level.

content.name: reset-on-leave
content.description: If enabled, all levels and the XP of a user will be deleted, when they leave your server.

content.name: randomMessages
content.description: If enabled the module will randomly select a messages from random-levelup-messages and ignore the one set in strings

content.name: leaderboard-channel
content.description: If set, the bot will send a messages in this channel with the current leaderboard and edit it every five minutes

content.name: leaderboard-channel-max-amount
content.humanName: Maximum amount of users displayed in live leaderboard Channel
content.description: This is the maximum amount of users displayed in the Live Leaderboard channel. /leaderboard will still show the full leaderboard.

content.name: maximumLevelEnabled
content.description: If enabled, users can only level until they reach the configured maximum level. After that, they can't level up and can't earn XP. Can be enabled retroactively.

content.name: maximumLevel
content.description: Once a user reaches this level, they neither earn more XP nor level up anymore.

content.name: startFromZero
content.description: If enabled, the initial level of users will be displayed as zero. This doesn't affect leveling, this is a cosmetic setting and can be applied retroactively.

content.name: useTags
content.humanName: Use User's Tags instead of their Mention in the Leaderboard-Channel-Embed
content.description: If enabled, the bot will use the tag of users in the Leaderboard-Channel-Embed instead of their mention.

content.name: allowCheats
content.description: If enabled admins can change the XP of other users (not recommended (please leave it off if you want to have a fair levelling system!!!))
